metadata.chapter_subtitle: Quantifying pollutant release and atmospheric transport from wildfires

inventory.summary: The smoke-dispersion chapter had a strong modelling structure but needed clearer onboarding and one substantive unit-scale correction in the emissions discussion.
issues: The chapter entered specialist atmospheric-dispersion material without a learner-facing setup block.
A CO2 emissions example overstated the result by three orders of magnitude in its unit label.
Minor escaped-currency markup interrupted the explanatory flow.

rewrite.summary: Added onboarding, repaired notation friction, and corrected the CO2 example while preserving the core emissions and dispersion model.
editor_notes: Added a Before You Start section.
Corrected the CO2 example from gigatonnes to megatonnes.
Kept the Gaussian and plume-rise treatment intact because it already fit the volume.

qa_review.summary: The chapter now enters more fairly for readers and the key numerical examples are mathematically consistent with their stated units.

repair.summary: The chapter was repaired through stronger reader scaffolding, one real numerical-unit fix, and minor notation cleanup.
actions_taken: Added a Before You Start section.
Corrected the CO2 example from 22.3 Gt to 22.3 Mt.
Repaired escaped-currency formatting in the health-cost section.

design_review.summary: The chapter already uses visuals and model structure effectively, and the revised framing improves how readers approach them.
improvements_made: Added learner-facing prerequisites and focus guidance.
Preserved the existing plume and dispersion visual support.
Improved interpretive fairness around the emissions-to-concentration chain.
